items.description: Flex Mail is a web application that provides address hygiene (CASS, NCOA, De-duplication) and postal sorting for bulk mailing through the USPS as a seamless embedded function. This application uses the TEC Mailing API.
Find rideshare matches among craigslist rideshare ads, according to your estimated route. Uses craigslist, Google Maps, and postgres.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.

Microsoft partnership that collects offers from various providers around the Web. Bing Deals brings visitors deals from 8coupons which aggregates deals from Restaurant.com, Yelp, LivingSocial and GiltCity, among many others.
FiWiStore provides a pleasant online shopping experience for internet user. Search, buy and review products through our easy to use online store.
A social, mobile, local experiment. Turn on my lamp in Brooklyn by signing up and checking-in!
Shopping comparison service with local shopping focus. Search for national products and see availability at stores near you.
InformScan provides a free people search engine that includes public records, emails, US addresses, phone numbers and more.
